prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures the chaotic intimacy of a theatre backstage. On the far left, a woman in a velvet gown sits on a wooden crate, her posture slumped in exhaustion. Beside her, a man in a tuxedo leans against a brick wall, holding a script tightly. In the center foreground, a large trunk with brass latches rests open, revealing tangled costumes inside. A stagehand in suspenders points at the trunk while talking to a dancer in a tutu who stands next to him. The dancer looks at a mirror propped against a pile of sandbags. Reflected in the glass is the face of an older man with white hair, who is adjusting his tie. To the right of the mirror, a cat with black fur sleeps atop a stack of scripts. Near the cat, a young boy in a cap hands a water bottle to a actress in a sequined dress. She accepts it with a weary smile. Behind them, a spotlight on a stand casts long shadows across the floorboards. A technician in a headset checks a cable connected to the spotlight. Next to the technician, a prop sword lies on the ground. A director in a beret watches the interaction between the boy and the actress from the background. A potted plant with drooping leaves sits near the exit door on the right. There is no audience visible in this private moment. There is no bright stage lighting illuminating the scene.
